name: smwmusic-mega-man-x4-chasing-the-light-jet-stingray-remix
title: Mega Man X4 - Chasing the Light ~ Jet Stingray (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Jet Stringray's Stage from Mega Man X4. Worst Maverick stage in the game, but goddamn, this song bangs so freaking hard, I can't help but forgive it because of it... until I have to get that damn subtank!!!

This baby is great for beach stages, athletic / sky stages, intense stages, boss fights, and auto-running stages.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
